title: The Will of the Fens
author: Ansel Eastwick
blurb: Kestrel Villalobos, a hotel concierge who notices everything, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
